what: KRAS G12C is a substitution in the KRAS gene, which belongs to the RAS family of proteins.
Mutations in the RAS family of proteins are frequently observed across cancer types, and the amino acid positions that account for the overwhelming majority of these mutations are G12, G13 and Q61.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions KRAS G12C, it is recording a finding about this gene change. This page lists public FDA companion diagnostics that look for KRAS G12C, and the therapies and trials in this snapshot that use KRAS G12C as a selection criterion. That mention is not a diagnosis or a treatment decision on its own.

lines.text: Adagrasib (KRAZATI) is listed on an FDA label in this snapshot. The FDA label lists this use: KRAZATI, as a single-agent, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), as determined by an FDA-approved test , who have received at least one prior systemic therapy. This indication is approved under accelerated approval. An EMA record for Krazati lists the status as Authorised, with an authorisation date of 09/11/2023.

Panitumumab (Vectibix) is listed on an FDA label in this snapshot. The FDA label lists this use: As monotherapy following disease progression after prior treatment with fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan-containing chemotherapy. KRAS G12C-mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC)* In combination with sotorasib, for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C- mutated mCRC, as determined by an FDA-approved test, who have received prior.

Sotorasib (LUMAKRAS) is an inhibitor of the RAS GTPase family. The FDA label lists this use: KRAS G12C-mutated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) As a single agent, for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC, as determined by an FDA-approved test, who have received at least one prior systemic therapy. This indication is approved. An EMA record for Lumykras lists the status as Authorised, with an authorisation date of 11/11/2021.
